name: Client failed to connect
definition: The client connection failed.

name: Client failed to obtain IP
definition: The client failed to obtain an IP address.

name: Interface IP address conflict
definition: An Interface IP address conflict was detected.

name: DHCP server conflicted
definition: A DHCP server conflict was detected.

name: Gateway client limit reached
definition: The number of connected clients has reached the device's limit.

name: Switch 802.1X authentication failure
definition: Switch 802.1X authentication failed.

name: Client Portal authentication failure
definition: Client Portal authentication failed.

name: Client Portal authentication too slow
definition: The client takes ≥ %threshold% s to communicate with a device/external service during portal authentication.

name: Switch 802.1X authentication took too long
definition: Switch 802.1X authentication took too long.

name: Client ping-pong roaming
definition: Within 5 min, the client roams between different bands of one AP or different APs %threshold% or more times.

name: Client sticky roaming
definition: The client is unable to roam.

name: AP channel utilization too high
definition: Within 15 min, the percentage of channel utilization samples exceeding %threshold%% is ≥ %count%%.

name: AP noise floor too high
definition: Within 15 min, the percentage of noise floor samples exceeding %threshold% dBm is ≥ %count%%.

name: AP wireless interference rate too high
definition: Within 15 min, the percentage of interference rate samples exceeding %threshold%% is ≥ %count%%.

name: Client SNR exception
definition: Within 15 min, the percentage of SNR samples below %threshold% dB is ≥ %count%%.

name: Client negotiation rate exception
definition: Within 15 min, the percentage of abnormal negotiation rate samples is ≥ %count%%.

name: Illegal multicast packet
definition: Illegal multicast packet was detected.

name: Host routing entry overflow
definition: Host routing entry overflow was detected.

name: ARP table overflow
definition: ARP table overflow was detected.

name: Multicast table overflow was detected
definition: Multicast table overflow was detected.

name: Switch port traffic too high
definition: Within 15 min, %count%% of the port traffic rate samples exceed %threshold%% of the maximum bandwidth of the port.

name: Switch LAG Group member port load too different
definition: Within 15 min, the difference between the highest and lowest member port rates exceeds %threshold%% in %count%% of the samples.

name: Switch port packet loss rate too high
definition: Within 15 min, %count%% of packet loss rate samples of a single port exceed %threshold%%.

name: Storm control event
definition: A storm control event occurred.

name: Loop detected
definition: A loop was detected.

name: LACP convergence failure
definition: LACP convergence failed.

name: Switch port detects error packets
definition: The port detected error packets.

name: Repeated address migrations
definition: Within %timeRange_s% s, the same MAC address migrated between different ports in the same VLAN %changedTimes% times.

name: Switch Port goes up/down frequently
definition: Within %timeRange% min, the port up/down status changed %changedTimes% times or more.

name: DDNS service abnormal
definition: DDNS service is abnormal.

name: Gateway WAN port bandwidth utilization rate too high
definition: Within 15 min, %count%% of WAN port traffic samples exceed %threshold%% of the Bandwidth Control value or %threshold%% of the WAN port physical bandwidth.

name: Gateway WAN port latency too high
definition: Within 15 min, %count%% of the WAN port latency samples exceed %threshold% ms.

name: VPN connection failure
definition: VPN connection failed.

name: AP frequently offline
definition: Within 1 hour, the AP goes offline %offlineCount% or more times.

name: APs on site going offline in batches
definition: When the total number of online APs is ≥ 6, the average number of APs going offline within 1 hour is ≥ %avgDisconnectCount%, the percentage of offline APs is ≥ %disconnectApPercent%%, or the number of offline APs is ≥ %disconnectCount%.

name: Gateway goes offline from the controller frequently
definition: Within 1 hour, the gateway goes offline %offlineCount% or more times.

name: AP CPU utilization rate too high
definition: Within 10 min, the percentage of CPU samples at or above %threshold%% is ≥ %count%%.

name: Gateway CPU utilization rate too high
definition: Within 10 min, the percentage of CPU samples at %threshold%% or higher is ≥ %count%%.

name: Switch goes offline frequently
definition: Within 1 hour, the switch goes offline %offlineCount% or more times.

name: Excessive PoE power
definition: PoE power exceeds limit.

name: Switch CPU utilization rate too high
definition: Within 10 min, the percentage of CPU samples at %threshold%% or higher is ≥ %count%%.

name: Abnormal optical module DDM
definition: The optical module has abnormal parameters.

name: Unauthorized log in from a gateway
definition: Within 10 min, an unauthorized user attempted to log in to the device via the serial port/TELNET/SSH/WEB.

name: Gateway WAN or LAN port detected attack packets
definition: Gateway WAN or LAN port detected attack packets.

name: Unauthorized log in from a switch
definition: Within 10 min, an unauthorized user attempted to log in to the device via the serial port/TELNET/SSH/WEB %retryCnt% or more times.

name: AP receiving weak mesh signals
definition: Within 15 min, the percentage of AP RSSI samples at or below %threshold% dBm is ≥ %count%%.

name: Uplink AP offline
definition: Uplink AP is offline.

name: Uplink AP disconnected and device out of range of other APs
definition: The uplink AP is disconnected, and the device is not within the detection range of other APs.

name: Mesh AP isolated
definition: Mesh AP is in the Isolated state.

name: Client association failure
definition: The client association failed.

name: Client frequently offline
definition: Within 15 min, the client goes offline %offlineCount% or more times.

name: Low client association success rate
definition: Within 1 hour, the number of client associations is ≥ 8, and the association success rate is ≤ %threshold%%.

name: Client authentication failure
definition: The client authentication failed.

name: Low client authentication success rate
definition: Within 1 hour, the number of client authentications is ≥ 8, and the authentication success rate is ≤ %threshold%%.

name: Low AP client association success rate
definition: Within 1 hour, the number of associated clients under the AP is ≥ 8, the total number of associations is ≥ 8, and the success rate of all association events is ≤ %threshold%%.

name: Low AP client authentication success rate
definition: Within 1 hour, the number of authenticated clients under the AP is ≥ 8, the total number of authentications is ≥ 8, and the success rate of all authentication events is ≤ %threshold%%.

name: Abnormal client disconnection
definition: The client disconnected abnormally.

name: Client slow to connect
definition: The client takes ≥ %threshold% ms to complete association and authentication.

name: Client slow to obtain IP
definition: The client takes ≥ %threshold% ms to obtain an IP address.

name: Low AP client roaming success rate
definition: Within 1 hour, the successful roaming rate is ≤ %threshold%%.

name: Client roams frequently
definition: Within 1 hour, the client roams %threshold% or more times.

name: Client roams slowly
definition: Within 1 hour, the percentage of all client roaming times exceeding %duration% s is > %threshold%%.

name: Abnormal AP reboot
definition: The AP rebooted abnormally.

name: AP temperature too high
definition: Within 10 min, the device's temperature is too high.

name: Client negotiation rate distribution exception
definition:
Within 15 min, on the 2.4 GHz band, the percentage of the samples of the client's normal negotiation rate under the AP is ≤ %count2g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz band, the percentage of the samples of the client's normal negotiation rate under the AP is ≤ %count5g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz-2 band, the percentage of the samples of the client's normal negotiation rate under the AP is ≤ %count5g2%%.
Within 15 min, on the 6 GHz band, the percentage of the samples of the client's normal negotiation rate under the AP is ≤ %count6g%%.

name: Client interferes with low negotiation rate
definition:
Within 15 min, on the 2.4 GHz band, the client negotiation rate is abnormal, the throughput is ≥ %throughput2g% Mb, and the channel utilization rate of this band is ≥ %util2g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz band, the client negotiation rate is abnormal, the throughput is ≥ %throughput5g% Mb, and the channel utilization rate of this band is ≥ %util5g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz-2 band, the client negotiation rate is abnormal, the throughput is ≥ %throughput5g2% Mb, and the channel utilization rate of this band is ≥ %util5g2%%.
Within 15 min, on the 6 GHz band, the client negotiation rate is abnormal, the throughput is ≥ %throughput6g% Mb, and the channel utilization rate of this band is ≥ %util6g%%.

name: Client retransmission rate too high
definition: Within 15 min, the percentage of the client retransmission rate samples exceeding %threshold%% is ≥ %count%%.

name: Client packet loss rate too high
definition: Within 15 min, the percentage of the client packet loss rate samples exceeding %threshold%% is ≥ %count%%.

name: AP retransmission rate too high
definition:
Within 15 min, on the 2.4 GHz band, the percentage of the AP retransmission rate samples exceeding %threshold2g%% is ≥ %count2g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz band, the percentage of the AP retransmission rate samples exceeding %threshold5g%% is ≥ %count5g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz-2 band, the percentage of the AP retransmission rate samples exceeding %threshold5g2%% is ≥ %count5g2%%.
Within 15 min, on the 6 GHz band, the percentage of the AP retransmission rate samples exceeding %threshold6g%% is ≥ %count6g%%.

name: AP packet loss rate too high
definition:
Within 15 min, on the 2.4 GHz band, the percentage of the AP packet loss rate samples exceeding %threshold2g%% is ≥ %count2g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz band, the percentage of the AP packet loss rate samples exceeding %threshold5g%% is ≥ %count5g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz-2 band, the percentage of the AP packet loss rate samples exceeding %threshold5g2%% is ≥ %count5g2%%.
Within 15 min, on the 6 GHz band, the percentage of the AP packet loss rate samples exceeding %threshold6g%% is ≥ %count6g%%.

name: Client signal strength distribution exception
definition:
Within 15 min, less than %ratio2g%% of clients on the 2.4 GHz band have a signal strength between %lowerThreshold2g% dBm and %upperThreshold2g% dBm.
Within 15 min, less than %ratio5g%% of clients on the 5 GHz band have a signal strength between %lowerThreshold5g% dBm and %upperThreshold5g% dBm.
Within 15 min, less than %ratio5g2%% of clients on the 5 GHz-2 band have a signal strength between %lowerThreshold5g2% dBm and %upperThreshold5g2% dBm.
Within 15 min, less than %ratio6g%% of clients on the 6 GHz band have a signal strength between %lowerThreshold6g% dBm and %upperThreshold6g% dBm.

name: Layer 3 interface down
definition: Layer 3 interface is down.

name: DHCP address pool warning
definition: More than %addressPoolRate%% of the address pool’s available resources have been allocated.

name: DHCP address pool exhausted
definition: The DHCP address pool is exhausted.

name: Address table overflow alarm
definition: The number of MAC addresses reached 99% of the maximum value that the device can learn.

name: Switch temperature too high
definition: Within 10 min, switch temperature is too high.

name: PoE power supply disruption
definition: The PoE stopped supplying power.

name: PoE short circuit
definition: The PoE short circuited.

name: Optical module DDM below threshold
definition: The optical module DDM is below the threshold.

name: Optical module not recognized
definition: The optical module cannot be recognized.

name: 802.1X authentication success rate too low
definition: Within 1 hour, the 802.1X authentication success rate is lower than %successRate%%.

name: 802.1X authentication takes too long
definition: Within 1 hour, %count%% of the sampling data exceeds %threshold% ms.

name: DNS service abnormal
definition: DNS service is abnormal.

name: Gateway fan abnormal
definition: Gateway fan is abnormal.

name: Gateway temperature too high
definition: Within 10 min, the device's temperature is too high.

name: Gateway WAN port packet loss rate too high
definition: Within 15 min, %count%% of the WAN port packet loss rate samples exceed %threshold%%.

name: site's successful portal authentication rate too low
definition: Within 1 hour, in the site, the clients' portal authentication success rate is less than or equal to %threshold%%.

name: WAN port dial-up failed
definition: WAN port dial-up failed.
